canonical_rule_rows.written_solution: Magenta(6) connected components get recolored by adjacent label cell color. Labels and solo markers removed. Unlabeled shapes keep magenta(6).
canonical_rule_rows.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (visited (make-hash))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (and (= (at g r c) 6) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))
                       (let bfs
                            ((q (list (list r c))))
                            (unless
                              (null? q)
                              (let ((cr (first (car q)))
                                    (cc (second (car q))))
                                (cond
                                  ((or
                                     (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                     (< cr 0)
                                     (>= cr h)
                                     (< cc 0)
                                     (>= cc w)
                                     (!= (at g cr cc) 6)) (bfs (cdr q)))
                                  (else (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                                        (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                                        (bfs (append (cdr q)
                                                     (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                           (list cr (+ cc 1))))))))))
                       (let ((label 6))
                         (for ((cell cells))
                           (for ((d (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))
                             (let ((nr (+ (first cell) (first d)))
                                   (nc (+ (second cell) (second d))))
                               (when
                                 (and
                                   (>= nr 0)
                                   (< nr h)
                                   (>= nc 0)
                                   (< nc w)
                                   (!= (at g nr nc) bg)
                                   (!= (at g nr nc) 6))
                                 (set! label (at g nr nc))))))
                         (for ((cell cells)) (hash-set! result cell label))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
